facts.fact: Communications minister Samuel Nartey George said on 5 September 2026 that the government will upgrade all Rural Telephony Project sites to at least 4G, with about GH¢30 million allocated to rural telephony under the GIFEC budget this year.
The minister said about 1,400 Rural Telephony Project sites are carrying traffic, with another 300 complete awaiting connection and about 300 under construction towards a target of 2,016 sites.

systems.owner: Ghana Investment Fund for Electronic Communications (GIFEC)
